jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated small isometric board-game stage diorama illustration, as a transparent art component inside a mobile stage map. Create completely new 2D painted cartoon art from this description, with clean rounded forms and modest smooth local shading, charming miniature objects and clear readable silhouettes. Cohesive single three-quarter isometric-style viewpoint looking modestly downward; all objects share the same camera and scale, vertical walls upright. Painted visual depth only, not a new 3D engine. Keep every part fully within a square canvas with at least 8% transparent margin. True transparent alpha background. Local shading stays within object silhouettes. No external ground shadow, cast-shadow plane, surrounding glow, clouds, sky, scene background, map path dots, ribbons, labels, numbers, logos, letters, card frames, padlock, interaction graphics, cursor, hand, or pawn. No written content anywhere. Include only the described miniature stage, including its own small physical island/base. Never reuse screenshot pixels.
Subject: A miniature Tokyo shrine-garden stage on a small shallow oval floating grassy island with a cream stone path running from the front edge through a large vivid red torii gate. The torii has two tall round red columns, a broad red crossbeam with softly upturned tips, a flat muted jade-green cap with narrow golden end accents, and one small central golden shrine ornament. Under the crossbeam hangs a rope decorated with plain white zigzag paper streamers; no written symbols. Dense fluffy pink cherry-blossom trees frame the gate at both sides, with a few small green shrubs and simple cream/gray path stones. Tiny tan shrine visitors may appear as simple figures on the path if needed, but the torii and pink blossoms dominate. All components sit naturally on the single island. No ribbon under the island.

Subject: A miniature cozy child's treasure-and-toy room on a small shallow round cream wooden floor platform, shown as an open-front room corner with two curved warm pale-yellow back walls. Each wall has one tall arched white-grid window. Center stage is a whimsical turquoise toy castle made of blocks: a tall central square tower with a tiny orange-red roof, lower turrets and a few orange-roofed small towers. The castle rests on a low dark reddish-brown wooden table with curved legs over an orange circular rug. At front-left sits an open gray treasure chest with a few golden coins inside. At right are a few cream and turquoise toy blocks. In front, a rolled pale paper and two small colored pencils lie on the floor. A small blue toy biplane rests on the upper-left wall edge; a round little clock and a couple plain star-shaped wall decorations are permitted but contain no numbers or words. Everything belongs to the small open room diorama; no background beyond the room's physical cutout walls. No ribbon below.

Subject: A miniature Monaco motor-racing stage on a small shallow oval green island. At the back-center stand stepped cream and pale-pink rectangular city/grandstand buildings with light blue glass panels. A prominent shiny golden trophy shaped as a tiny standing celebratory racing figure holding a cup is mounted high on a pale cream pedestal above the central building. A compact looping gray race track curves across the foreground, with alternating red-orange and white curb segments. Two tiny rounded open-wheel race cars sit on the track, one warm red-orange and one dark charcoal with a red cockpit. A few small rounded green shrubs/trees and a tiny turquoise parasol decorate the edges. All structures share the same coherent miniature isometric viewpoint. Golden trophy is dominant upper shape, racing loop dominant base shape. No text, racing numerals, flags or ribbon. Use the described observed unlocked color palette, not gray locked tint.
